main.description: Record the email address on the caller's PDS account with HappyProto, read server-side from their PDS session. The dashboard calls it once after each sign-in. The address is reported only when the session was granted transition:email; without one, the last recorded address is kept. Customers and staff; anyone else gets recorded = false.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID the client generates once per sign-in and resends on every retry of it.

recorded.description: Whether the caller has a HappyProto account to record it against: false for anyone who is neither a customer nor staff.

email.description: The address HappyProto now holds for the caller, if any: this sign-in's, or the last one recorded.

emailConfirmed.description: Whether the PDS reported that address as confirmed, when it said.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: idempotencyKey is missing or not a UUID, or the provisioner refused the request as malformed.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: The provisioner is unreachable, not configured, or answered with an error it does not explain to callers.
